newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle lightly bid $2-$3 lower - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle lightly bid $2-$3 lower - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle were lightly bid Wednesday at $106 to $107 per cwt on a dressed basis, down from sales Tuesday at $108.00 to $110.00 per cwt, market sources said.
No trades were reported but sources said cattle feeders may consider accepting the lower bids on lower-grading cattle.

As in the southern Plains, Nebraska sources said feedlots are largely full but placements have slowed since the active pace in November. They also said it is now difficult to profitably hedge newly-placed cattle against CME cattle futures and CBOT corn futures.
